title: Oven Baked Croatian Cheese Casserole
description: A comforting Croatian dish featuring cheese slices and a lacquer glaze, perfect for a spring evening, this jain-friendly recipe is floral and springy.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Prepare the lacquer glaze according to the recipe or package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and sauté the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked onion and garlic, chopped parsley, cheese slices, salt, and black pepper.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour and vegetable broth until smooth.
Add the flour mixture to the cheese mixture and stir until well combined.
Pour the lacquer glaze over the top of the cheese mixture and smooth out the top.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake for 35 minutes or until the top is golden brown.
